title: Light Saber  Swords
description: This project replaces the diamond sword to be a blue light saber, and the netherite sword to be a red lightsaber, so you can image yourself in your favourite movie.
body:
With the New red and blue light sabers, you can recreate your favourite scenes from the movie.
- Red Light Saber [netherite sword]
- Blue Light Saber [Diamond Sword]
There are no models yet as I do not know how to code it in, but I might work on it. You can use this pack in videos, but pls do not take credit for the pack / claim it as your's, ty :)
